full_name_ar: ربيعة بن زرارة العتكي أبو الحلال ب
bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir calls him Abu al-Halal al-Ataki of Basra, who heard from Uthman ibn Affan; Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat also says he narrated from Uthman. The material from Ahmad ibn Hanbal (al-Jami li-Ulum al-Imam Ahmad: al-Rijal) notes his name is also given as Zurara ibn Rabi'a, and reports that he died aged 120 and that al-Muhallab ibn Abi Sufra sent him a slave girl when he was 110.
